step1_figure.circuit_type: Beta-Multiplier Reference (Constant-gm Bias Circuit) with Start-up Circuit
step1_figure.description: Figure 20.15 illustrates a supply-independent Beta-multiplier reference circuit comprising NMOS devices M1-M2, PMOS mirror M3-M4, degeneration resistor R, and an active start-up circuit formed by MSU1, MSU2, and MSU3 to avoid the zero-current state.

iref.description: Reference bias current generated by the Beta-multiplier core

equation.explanation: Derived by equating VGS1 to VGS2 + IREF * R with beta2 = K * beta1.
equation.assumptions: Square-law saturation, neglected channel-length modulation lambda=0, long-channel operation

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard square-law calculation gives ~8.77 uA; second-order effects and threshold shifts in SKY130 typically set the current between 7 uA and 11 uA.

gm.description: Transconductance of NMOS device M1, designed to be constant and process-independent

equation.explanation: When K=4, the bracket evaluates to 0.5, cancelling the 2 and leaving gm fixed to the reciprocal of the resistor value.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined primarily by the resistor value R = 6.5 kOhm with K = 4.

vds_sat1.description: Saturation overdrive voltage of NMOS device M1 (Vovn = VGS1 - VTHN)

equation.explanation: Overdrive voltage required to support current IREF through M1 with transconductance set by R.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Nominal value from square law calculation is 114 mV, well within saturation limits.

vgs1.description: Gate-to-source bias voltage of diode-connected NMOS M1 (Vbiasn)

equation.formula: VGS1 = VTHN + Vovn = VTHN + sqrt(2 * I_REF / beta1)
equation.explanation: Total gate-source voltage needed to conduct the reference current IREF.

sky130_expected.calculation: VGS1 = VTHN + Vovn = 0.42 V + 0.114 V = 0.534 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: VTHN in SKY130 is ~0.42 V; with overdrive of ~0.11 V, Vbiasn settles near 0.53 V.

delta_vgs.description: Difference between gate-source voltages of M1 and M2 (voltage dropped across R)

equation.explanation: Loop equation around M1 gate-source, M2 gate-source, and resistor R.
equation.assumptions: KVL holds around the input NMOS loop

sky130_expected.calculation: delta_VGS = I_REF * R = 8.766 uA * 6500 Ohm = 0.057 V (57 mV).

vdd_min.description: Minimum supply voltage required for proper circuit regulation

equation.explanation: Minimum VDD ensures PMOS M3 is in saturation while maintaining VGS1 at the drain.
equation.assumptions: PMOS in saturation: VSD3 >= VSD3,sat; M1 in saturation

sky130_expected.reasoning: Below ~0.7 V, PMOS M3/M4 enter triode and current falls precipitously toward zero.

supply_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of reference current to supply voltage variations (dIREF / dVDD)

equation.formula: dIREF / dVDD = (IREF * lambda) / (1 + gm2 * R * ro)
equation.explanation: Determined by finite drain output resistance of M2 and M4 causing channel length modulation as VDD increases.

sky130_expected.calculation: For L=2 um long channels, lambda is around 0.05 - 0.1 V^-1. With degeneration gm*R ~ 1, sensitivity is approximately dIREF/dVDD ~ 0.5 uA/V to 1.5 uA/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Textbook reports ~800 nA/V for long channel Beta-multiplier at 2 um length.

startup_leakage_current.description: Leakage current through startup switch MSU3 during normal operation

equation.explanation: During normal operation MSU1 pulls the gate of MSU3 low, turning it off so it does not disturb the mirror currents.
equation.assumptions: Vbiasn > VTHN_MSU1 turns MSU1 on, discharging gate of MSU3 to ground

sky130_expected.calculation: MSU1 gate is at Vbiasn ~ 0.53 V > Vth (0.42 V), driving node N001 down close to 0 V. MSU3 has VGS <= 0 V, conducting only subthreshold leakage (< 10 pA).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Start-up circuit must disengage completely once normal bias is reached.

power.description: Total quiescent power dissipation of the reference circuit at VDD = 1.8 V

equation.explanation: Sum of currents drawn from the VDD rail multiplied by supply voltage.
equation.assumptions: Normal operating state (startup branch current negligible)

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current IDD = ID3 + ID4 ~= 2 * IREF = 2 * 8.77 uA = 17.54 uA. Power = 1.8 V * 17.54 uA = 31.57 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Circuit consists of two active branches drawing ~8.8 uA each from 1.8 V.

step3_testbench.description: ngspice testbench for Beta-Multiplier Reference circuit (Fig 20.15), measuring reference current, transconductance, overdrive, minimum supply voltage, startup disengagement, supply sensitivity, and power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Beta-Multiplier Reference Testbench (Baker Fig. 20.15)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmsu1=10u L_xmsu1=2u
.param W_xmsu2=10u L_xmsu2=100u
.param W_xmsu3=10u L_xmsu3=1u
.param W_xm1=10u   L_xm1=2u
.param W_xm2=40u   L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm3=30u   L_xm3=2u
.param W_xm4=30u   L_xm4=2u

* Circuit Under Test
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xmsu2 N001 N001 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu2} l={L_xmsu2}
xmsu1 N001 Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu1} l={L_xmsu1}
xmsu3 Vbiasp N001 Vbiasn 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xmsu3} l={L_xmsu3}
xm3 Vbiasn Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 Vbiasp Vbiasp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm1 Vbiasn Vbiasn 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 Vbiasp Vbiasn N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
R1 N002 0 6500.0

.control
set filetype=ascii

* === Operating Point Analysis ===
op

let iref = v(N002) / 6500.0
let vgs1 = v(Vbiasn)
let vgs2 = v(Vbiasn) - v(N002)
let delta_vgs = v(N002)
let gm_calc = 1.0 / 6500.0
let vovn = 2.0 * delta_vgs
let pwr = -i(VDD) * 1.8
let v_n001 = v(N001)

print iref vgs1 vgs2 delta_vgs gm_calc vovn pwr v_n001

* === DC Supply Sweep ===
dc VDD 0 1.8 0.01

let iref_sweep = v(N002) / 6500.0
let iref_target = 0.9 * iref

meas dc vdd_min when iref_sweep=iref_target rise=1
meas dc iref_1v6 find iref_sweep at=1.6
meas dc iref_1v8 find iref_sweep at=1.8

let supply_sens = (iref_1v8 - iref_1v6) / 0.2
print supply_sens

quit
.endc
.end
